This project runs on the **ng-autopilot AI workspace**. Development is AI-only: the owner decides scope, open questions, product calls and pushes; agents do the rest.

## Where things are

| Need | Where |
|---|---|
| **Project rules** — product, the project's hard rules, do-not-modify, and which doc to read before what | [.claude/rules/project.md](.claude/rules/project.md) (loads when you open project files) |
| **Project docs** — read the one the work needs | __DOCS__ |
| Autopilot rules (Angular, TypeScript, workflow, security, …) | `.claude/rules/autopilot/` (load automatically) |
| Gate commands, smoke map, visual-gate setup, security triggers | [.claude/gates.md](.claude/gates.md) |
| Test-tier project rules | `.claude/<tier>-testing/overrides.md` |
| Active work (plan + worklog) | `.claude/plans/<slug>/` |
| Workspace settings (packs, planning, lint scope, i18n) | [.claude/autopilot.json](.claude/autopilot.json) |
| Backlog (deferred work, parked ideas) | [.claude/plans/backlog.md](.claude/plans/backlog.md) |

## How work happens

- **Every change goes through `/deliver`**: plan → plan gate (owner) → implement → checkpoint → test phase → smoke/visual gates → review → triage → final gate → PR (owner approves the push). `/review` reviews any branch or PR.
- **Mode:** `fast` / `balanced` (default) / `strict`. **Planning format:** __PLANNING__.
- **Packs:** __PACKS__. **Test tiers:** __TEST_TIERS__. **Lint strict scope:** __STRICT_SCOPE__ — every autopilot rule applies there with no exceptions. Code outside it is legacy: bug fixes only, in the file's existing style; new work goes inside the scope.
- **API:** __API__
